theme.aria: Chynge atween licht an dairk theme
index.title: AI-gile: yer AI dev team, on the ae board
index.description: AI-gile is a kanban board for AI codin teams. They wirk while ye sleep; ye get the ae wee pile o things tae decide, test an accept.
hero.h1.html: Yer AI dev team, on the ae board.
hero.alphaTitle: Early an unfinished: thanks for tryin it!
hero.lede: They big while ye sleep. Ye wauken tae the ae wee pile: a few questions, a few things tae test, a purple diamond or twa. Clap, accept, an back tae yer coffee.
hero.secondary: Agile, but the team niver needs a stand-up coffee. (They dae stand-ups onieweys.)
pitch.h2: AI-gile in as mony words as ye like
pitch.lede: Pick a length, frae the ae word tae 144. Ilka length is its ain description, scrievit for that size. Drag the slider or use the arrow keys.
count.line.html.one: {n} caird on the board richt noo
count.line.html.other: {n} cairds on the board richt noo
f.pile.html: For ye haulds awthing waitin on ye, athort ilka project: questions, things tae test, jobs only a body can dae. Yer queue tells ye whit's neist an hou lang it taks.
f.sleep.h: Teams that wirk while ye sleep
f.sleep.p: Ilka project haes a lead an a team o AI agents. Comment on a caird an the team wakes up, daes the wirk, an hauns it back wi steps a tired body can follae.
f.tester.p: Afore onything reaches ye, a tester follaes the steps in a copy o the app an shaws whit it saw, wi a screenshot. Flick thro the anes that passed an accept in a clap.
f.proof.p: Ilka haun-ower shaws whit chynged: the files, the diff, the screenshots. Nae openin ilka app tae see if it's duin.
f.chat.p: A Discord-style rail: ae icon per project, purple diamonds for whit needs ye. Message a lead an idea; they turn it intae cairds an a plan, wi a ✅ Go button.
f.tidy.p: Related cairds fauld intae ane, muddled titles get fixed, an a token check keeps the code lean. Fewer things tae flit atween, less tae think on.
f.private.li1: The board rins on yer ain machine an only answers tae ye.
f.private.li2: Private DMs atween fowk are end-tae-end encryptit.
f.private.li3: Nae accounts, nae trackers, nae cookies.
f.lang.p: Ower 120 leids, frae Dutch, Welsh an Japanese tae pirate, Yoda an Klingon, wi a quick switch back tae English for the developer words.
tl.aria: Timeline frae the first blether tae the roadmap
tl.h2: Frae the first blether tae whit's neist
tl.lede: Real dates an times, in yer ain time zone. Efter the day it's the plan, wi nae dates promised.
join.lede: AI-gile is bein biggit by a wee human an a hantle o patient agents. It's private for noo, in a steekit alpha wi freends. Fancy a shot when it opens up?
footer.tag: AI-gile. Nae trackers, nae cookies, nae stand-up coffee.
form.failed: That didnae wirk: try again later.
form.offline: Couldnae reach AI-gile: try again later.
interest.title: AI-gile: tell me when the alpha opens
interest.description: Leave yer email tae hear when AI-gile's steekit alpha or beta opens.
interest.lede: AI-gile is in steekit pre-alpha. Leave yer email an we'll write the ae time, when there's a place for ye.
interest.alpha: Steekit alpha: early, rouch, lots o chynges
interest.kept: Only yer email an the test ye picked are kept, for this list only. Nae newsletter, nae trackers.

licence.lede: Usin AI-gile at wirk? Tell us wha ye are an whit ye dae. If it daes some guid, the licence is free.
